the DGT and DGT-based techniques are not suitable for the classification of the considered ultrasonic signals; that the DWT-based technique is suitable for the classification, and that the clustered DWT technique is superior to the DWT one.

the clustered DWT is the most effective method for feature extraction from ultrasonic signals, with respect to DGT and DGT, and that this method is also the most computationally efficient.

the development of a new method to classify ultrasonic NDE data, based on the DWT, and to compare it with the DGT and the DWT techniques.
the development of a new technique of feature extraction, based on the DWT and the clustering of the wavelet coefficients, which allows to achieve a good classification of ultrasonic signals.
the application of the DWT and DGT to the classification of ultrasonically detected flaws in the piping of nuclear power plant components.

the DWT method is the most effective one in the classification of ultrasonographic signals.
the clustering of wavelet coefficients, in addition to the wavelet coefficients, is the best technique for feature extraction of the ultrasonic signals, in terms of classification performance.
the DWT technique with clustering of the coefficients is the most effective and efficient feature extractor for the classification of the considered ultrasonic NDE signal patterns.
